labels.environment: Every node is a dkv-server process on the machine below, with its data on ext4; the load generator runs on the same machine. 16 shards (and the meta group).
labels.title: Optimizations
labels.what: Three nodes, RF 3, writes only: the Phase 9 build, in which a replica fsyncs its Raft log and then its engine's log for every write and a leader persists before replicating; then this build with the engine's log kept (storage.engine_wal), which isolates the leader replicating while it writes to its own disk (Raft thesis 10.2.1); then this build's default, the Raft log as a replica's only log (docs/adr/0010).
